arStrings.szText: Belial's story is complete. Continue targeting {c_highlight}Bosses{/c} and collecting {icon:Item_BossPower_Currency, 2.3} {c_highlight}Spectral Ash{/c} to master {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Boss_Selected, 2.} {c_highlight}Boss Powers{/c}.

Fight powerful {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair,1.8} {c_highlight}Lair Bosses{/c} across Sanctuary for immense rewards and a chance at build-defining {c:FFfa950f}Ancestral{/c} and {c:FFd5b3e6}Mythic Unique{/c} Items.
Various activities yield materials to summon {c_highlight}Tier 1 Lair Bosses{/c}. Defeating them earns materials to summon more powerful {c_highlight}Tier 2 Lair Bosses{/c}.
Each Lair Boss has a unique reward pool. Higher-tiered Lair Bosses have a greater chance at {c:FFd5b3e6}Mythic Unique{/c} Items.
{icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionBelial, 2.3} {c_highlight}Belial, Lord of Lies,{/c} waits to ambush after any defeated Lair Boss. Defeat him to earn materials to fight his supreme form!
